reviews.title: Clean collaborative consent export
reviews.reviewerNote: public health: ethics, consent, comments, and export scope are publication-ready.

reviews.title: Vulnerable population review needs refresh

findings.message: The manuscript includes vulnerable participant groups without documented enhanced ethics review.
findings.remediation: Add vulnerable-population review evidence and consent safeguards before publication export.

findings.message: Required consent-language coverage is missing for one or more participant groups.
findings.remediation: Add translated consent evidence or justify why those participant groups are not included in the export.

findings.message: The last ethics-section review is older than the configured freshness window.
findings.remediation: Refresh ethics reviewer signoff after the latest collaborative edits.

findings.message: An ethics-section comment remains unresolved at export time.
findings.remediation: Resolve or explicitly defer the ethics comment before publication export.

reviews.reviewerNote: education research: REVIEW before export because the manuscript includes vulnerable participant groups without documented enhanced ethics review.

reviews.title: Human-subjects packet without approval

findings.message: The manuscript involves human subjects but lacks an ethics approval identifier.
findings.remediation: Add the IRB/REC approval identifier or mark the study as exempt with supporting rationale.

findings.message: Consent is required but no consent statement is present in the collaborative manuscript.
findings.remediation: Add a consent statement or documented waiver before export.

findings.message: Required consent-language coverage is missing for one or more participant groups.
findings.remediation: Add translated consent evidence or justify why those participant groups are not included in the export.

reviews.reviewerNote: clinical methods: HOLD before export because the manuscript involves human subjects but lacks an ethics approval identifier.

reviews.title: Private participant details leaking through comments

findings.message: A locked ethics or consent section has pending collaborative edits without approved override.
findings.remediation: Route pending edits through the section owner or ethics reviewer before export.

findings.message: A private ethics or reviewer comment is marked visible in the export packet.
findings.remediation: Redact or remove private comments before creating the public manuscript export.

findings.message: A collaborative comment appears to contain a participant, subject, patient, MRN, or DOB marker.
findings.remediation: Redact participant identifiers and regenerate reviewer-safe comments before export.

findings.message: An ethics-section comment remains unresolved at export time.
findings.remediation: Resolve or explicitly defer the ethics comment before publication export.
